messages:
alex: Quick design question — attaching a small mock: https://img.redwood/ux/pin-rollback.png. Looking for input on the pin/unpin UX when a model variant rollout is in progress. Current idea: a compact 'Pin version' dropdown on the row with options: 'Pin to current', 'Revert to pinned', and a tiny badge showing 'pinned' + optional canary dot. Any accessibility or density concerns?
maria: Love the intent. Main concern is contrast — the grey badge color right now is too low contrast on the table background. Also keyboard users: the pin control needs a clear focus target and aria attributes (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded) if it opens a menu.
sam: Agree on contrast. Also we saw user confusion with a state we called 'pinned but not active' last quarter. Users thought pinning would route production traffic immediately. Suggest tooltip copy: "Pinned to v1.2 — will not follow auto-rollouts". Keep it short.
jin: Row density note — adding another visible column for badges will push metric columns out on smaller widths. Options: collapse badges into the overflow menu on narrow widths or move pin indicator into the model name cell as a leading icon so we don't add to column count.
emily: Copy nit: 'Revert to pinned' feels heavy. Maybe 'Revert' as the action with a hover detail that says 'Revert to pinned version v1.2'. For screen readers, use aria-label: 'Revert to pinned version v1.2 — opens confirmation'.
a11y-bot: Automated check: current badge color (#6B7280) fails AA small text contrast on #FFFFFF. Suggestions that pass AA: #374151 or #111827. Also ensure focus ring >= 3px for visibility.
maria: For performance badges, let's show p50 inline when available (e.g., "p50 45ms") and keep colored dot as an at-a-glance signal. Tooltip should include p50/p95 and throughput with a link to the console route metrics.
alex: I like inline p50 fallback to '—' when unknown. One UX question: in compare mode, how do we indicate pinning differences? My thought: show a small pinned-marker in each compared row, and in the expanded compare pane show the pinned version string (short hash + semantic tag).
sam: Edge case: what if a pinned version is later deleted from the catalog? We need a graceful fallback: show 'pinned (missing)' with actions: 'Unpin' and 'Restore from snapshot' (if available). Add unit/integration tests for that flow.
jin: Accessibility reminder: keyboard-only users should be able to reach the pin badge and open the menu. Suggest adding role="button" tabindex="0" to the badge and this CSS for focus: 
```
.pin-badge:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); border-radius: 4px; }
```
Also announce state changes with live region: aria-live="polite" when pin state updates.
emily: Proposed microcopy for confirm modal: 'Revert production traffic to version v1.2? This will pin your route and stop automatic rollouts.' Primary button: 'Revert and pin' (danger style), secondary: 'Cancel'. Add a one-line hint: 'This action can be undone by unpinning.'
alex: Nice. Action items: maria — provide accessible color tokens and badge sizes; jin — add focus/cursor attributes and aria-live implementation; emily — draft exact copy for tooltips and confirmation modal; sam — spec missing-version fallback and tests. I'll update Figma this afternoon and post new screenshot. Thanks everyone! :heart:
